title: The Sky Line
synopsis: The last train races the Hush to Lantern Hill. When the track ends in the dark, an old friend comes down from the sky.
clever_move: Rook switches tracks at the last second; the Hush's hand closes on empty air.
fear: Train stopped in total dark at the end of the line; the Hush right above, points at the passengers; 'Stay still. Please.'
surprise: The Long Back's song; the sky whale comes down, the train rides up on its back; the Hush can't fly.
closing_line: Next stop: wherever the light is.
places: the sky on the Long Back

title: Into the Dark
synopsis: The lamps behind the last train die one by one. The Hush is coming. Rook's only chance is a tunnel, and total darkness.
clever_move: Rook dives into a tunnel and turns off every light, even his own signal eye; the Hush's eyes search the dark and give up.
closing_line: It will find us again. It always does.

title: The Turntable
synopsis: The windmills stop, and the Hush rises on the line ahead. Rook runs the train backwards to an old turntable. But turning takes time.
clever_move: The Hush stands on the line ahead, so Rook runs the train backwards onto the old turntable and turns the whole train a quarter round onto the branch line.
fear: The table turns slowly in the dark; the Hush eats the yard lamps and the train's lights and stands right over them. '...Don't move. Not a sound.'
surprise: A gust starts the big old mill by the yard; its sails sweep between the Hush and the train and it steps back (not defeated, it follows them).
closing_line: Next stop: the town past the hills.

title: The Long Hill
synopsis: At the top of Long Hill the valley lights go out, and the Hush starts to climb toward the train. There is no way round. Only down.
clever_move: The Hush climbs Long Hill toward the train, so Rook closes the firebox, puts out every light (even his eye) and lets the train roll down the hill with no fire, no light, no sound, right past the Hush in the dark.
fear: The dark train rolls past the Hush's feet while it searches up the hill. '...Don't move. Not a sound.'
surprise: At the foot of the hill the old level crossing wakes up by itself, bell ringing and red lamps flashing; the Hush turns round and walks down after them (it will be back).
closing_line: The last train runs again tomorrow.
